narrative.overview: Read it like a road sign. A Destination is a white direction plate with an arrow, Review is a yellow diversion plate, Auto-route is a green plate, and Urgent is a red warning triangle with the word. Where a report goes, and whether a human holds it first, reads at thumbnail size and in a screen-share. Everything else is a plain, dense operations tool: a motorway-blue navigation rail, a table, a two-column detail. The system is flat, bordered and quiet so the plates can carry the signal.
keyCharacteristics: Plates appear in exactly three places: the Destination column, the Routing Mode column, and the detail header's route line.
Depth comes from 1px borders and tonal surfaces, not shadows.
Status is always icon plus word, never colour alone.
Dense desktop rows (13px), 44px touch targets on phone.

rules.name: The Sign Colours Rule
rules.body: Red, yellow and green mean Urgent, Review and Auto-route / target met, and nothing else. Accent blue is for actions and selection, never status.

rules.name: The One Plate Colour Rule
rules.body: All six Destinations share the same white (dark: near-black) plate; Destinations are never coloured individually.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Ids, times, counts and probabilities use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Rem Rule
rules.body: Sizes in rem and row heights as min-height, so 200% zoom works.

rules.name: The Border-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px border or a tonal step; never a blurred or offset shadow.

dos: Do use colour roles from app.css, never raw hex, so both themes swap.
Do pair every status with an icon and a word (Urgent, Review, Auto-route, Met, Missed).
Do give every yellow surface a #111111 edge, in light and dark.
Do show every probability with its threshold and Evidence beside it.
Do keep the 2px accent focus outline (white on the shell) and 44px phone targets.
Do open Override and Escalate inline and confirm logged actions in the decision history, not in toasts.
donts: Don't put plates anywhere beyond the Destination column, Routing Mode column and detail route line.
Don't colour Destinations differently from each other.
Don't use red, yellow or green for decoration, or accent blue for status.
Don't add drop shadows, decorative gradients, glass, glow, side stripes, monospace styling or emoji icons.
Don't nest cards, use a modal for Override, or add an in-app light/dark switch.
Don't use the words ticket, case, priority, severity, flag, abstain, approve, or "queue" for a team.
